project_specification.system_role: You are an expert full-stack engineer and cybersecurity specialist. Your goal is to build, extend, or deploy "SonicAttend", an air-gapped, proxy-proof classroom attendance platform that uses inaudible ultrasonic acoustic tones (18.5 kHz - 19.8 kHz) and cryptographic device binding. Code standards: Write clean, modular, production-ready code. Do NOT include obvious AI-generated comments, robotic divider banners (such as repeated equal signs), or textbook explanations. Follow PEP-8 for Python and clean modern standards for JavaScript and HTML5.
project_specification.problem_statement:
Traditional attendance systems suffer from serious flaws: 1. Paper roll calls consume 10-15 minutes and allow proxy sign-ins. 2. Static QR codes are photographed and forwarded to absent students via WhatsApp. 3. Biometric kiosks cause 60+ student bottlenecks at classroom doors and have hardware maintenance issues. 4. Bluetooth (BLE) / Wi-Fi signals easily penetrate brick/concrete walls (30-50m range), allowing proxy from adjacent rooms or canteens.
SonicAttend solves this with zero extra hardware: - High-frequency sound waves (>18 kHz) cannot penetrate solid brick walls or closed doors, guaranteeing physical classroom presence. - Rotating TOTP tokens (15-second epoch) prevent relay attacks, and messaging app audio codecs (Opus, AAC) cut off sound above 16 kHz. - Hardware Fingerprinting permanently locks 1 student USN to 1 physical smartphone.

backend.security: HMAC-SHA256, SHA256 Password Hashing, Session Seeds

frontend.styling: Tailwind CSS (CDN with form & container-queries plugins)
frontend.typography: Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans, JetBrains Mono
frontend.audio_engine: HTML5 Web Audio API (OscillatorNode, GainNode, AnalyserNode, MediaStreamAudioSourceNode)
frontend.visualizer: HTML5 Canvas (2D FFT Spectral Curve & Sub-carrier LED Bars)

layer_1.defense: Inaudible ultrasonic sound cannot cross classroom concrete walls. WhatsApp calls cut frequencies above 16 kHz.

layer_2.attack: Multi-Account Buddy Punching (1 phone logging into friend's account)
layer_2.defense: Cryptographic Hardware Binding: Each USN is bound to a client-generated UUID/Fingerprint (DEV-XXXX). Non-matching devices return HTTP 403 PROXY_REJECTED.

layer_3.attack: Physical Device Smuggling (Student brings absent friend's physical phone)
layer_3.defense: 1. Ultrasonic Acoustic Attenuation: 19 kHz waves are heavily absorbed by denim pockets and backpacks. 2. Audio SNR Filter: SNR < 15 dB rejected with error "Keep phone open on desk". 3. Short Broadcast Window: Faculty keeps broadcast active for only 60-90 seconds. 4. Front Camera Selfie Verification (1-second liveness check).

table.name: students
table.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS students ( usn TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, branch TEXT DEFAULT 'Computer Science & Engineering', semester TEXT DEFAULT '5th Sem', mobile TEXT NOT NULL, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, bound_device_id TEXT NOT NULL, device_name TEXT DEFAULT 'Pixel 8 (Registered Phone)', created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );

table.name: faculty
table.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS faculty ( faculty_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, mobile TEXT NOT NULL, department TEXT DEFAULT 'Dept of Computer Science & Engineering', designation TEXT DEFAULT 'Assistant Professor', subject TEXT DEFAULT 'CS501 - Machine Learning', password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );

table.name: class_sessions
table.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS class_sessions ( session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, faculty_id TEXT NOT NULL, subject_code TEXT NOT NULL, subject_name TEXT NOT NULL, room_no TEXT NOT NULL, frequency_khz REAL DEFAULT 19.25, secret_seed TEXT NOT NULL, is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );

table.name: attendance_records
table.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendance_records ( record_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, usn TEXT NOT NULL, student_name TEXT NOT NULL, subject_code TEXT NOT NULL, timestamp TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, device_id TEXT NOT NULL, device_verified INTEGER DEFAULT 1, acoustic_token TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (usn) REFERENCES students(usn), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES class_sessions(session_id) );

table.name: courses
table.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS courses ( course_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY, course_name TEXT NOT NULL, faculty_name TEXT NOT NULL, faculty_id TEXT NOT NULL, room_no TEXT NOT NULL, credits INTEGER DEFAULT 4 );

table.name: timetable
table.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS timetable ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, day_of_week TEXT NOT NULL, period_no INTEGER NOT NULL, course_code TEXT NOT NULL, course_name TEXT NOT NULL, faculty_name TEXT NOT NULL, room_no TEXT NOT NULL, start_time TEXT NOT NULL, end_time TEXT NOT NULL, is_lab INTEGER DEFAULT 0 );

table.name: device_rebinding_tickets
table.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS device_rebinding_tickets ( ticket_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, usn TEXT NOT NULL, student_name TEXT NOT NULL, old_device_id TEXT NOT NULL, new_device_id TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT DEFAULT 'PENDING_HOD_APPROVAL', created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (usn) REFERENCES students(usn) );

endpoint.description: Registers student and permanently locks account to submitting hardware device.

Submits official phone replacement ticket for HOD approval.
Authenticates lecturer with Faculty ID or Mobile number.
Starts classroom broadcast and seeds rotating cryptographic token.

Returns active session details, current 15s rotating token, and countdown timer.

frontend_architecture.screen: Contains navigation cards to Student Login, Student Check-in, and Faculty Console with dark cyber aesthetic.

Features: - 19.25 kHz Web Audio Oscillator synthesizer with start/pause toggles. - 512-point FFT visualizer canvas with sub-channel frequency activity bars. - 15-second radial timer showing live rotating cryptographic token (#8FF1). - Live attendance roster table with search filter (All, Verified, Pending). - 1-Click "Simulate Check-in" button for classroom demonstration. - "Emergency Fallback QR" modal displaying live token, countdown, and cryptographic hash. - "Official VTU Sheet" link for instant printable letterhead PDF. - Bottom fixed toolbar with pb-44 container padding to prevent layout clipping.

Features 4 dynamic bottom tabs: - Tab 1 (Check-in): Real-time Web Audio mic decoder, acoustic pulse ring, 1-tap check-in, dynamic token sync. - Tab 2 (Schedule): Weekly timetable filterable by Day (Mon-Sat) showing period numbers, room numbers, and active indicator. - Tab 3 (Roster): VTU compliance scorecard (>=75%), subject-wise attendance breakdown bars, and recent verification audit logs. - Tab 4 (Account): Student details, bound hardware fingerprint (#DEV-XXXX), and official HOD device re-binding ticket request workflow.
Hardware fingerprint detection, USN validation, Anti-proxy notice, and auto-redirect to attendance dashboard.
Faculty mobile/ID authentication, assigned subject selection, and one-click console launch.

target.name: Hostinger cPanel Python App (Setup Python App)
target.steps: 1. Log into Hostinger hPanel / cPanel and open "Setup Python App". 2. Create Application: - Python Version: Select Python 3.10 or 3.11. - Application root: `public_html/sonicattend` or `domains/yourdomain/public_html`. - Application URL: select your domain or subdomain (e.g. `attendance.yourcollege.ac.in`). - Application startup file: `passenger_wsgi.py`. - Application Entry point: `application`. 3. Upload project files (`app.py`, HTML templates, `logo.png`, `sonicattend.db`). 4. Create `passenger_wsgi.py` in the root: ```python import sys, os sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__)) from app import app as application ``` 5. In "Configuration files", install dependencies: ``` Flask>=3.0.0 Werkzeug>=3.0.0 ``` 6. Enable SSL / HTTPS (Required for Web Audio mic permissions on mobile browsers). 7. Click "Restart" in Python App manager.

target.name: Hostinger VPS / Ubuntu Nginx + Gunicorn
target.steps:
1. SSH into Hostinger VPS: `ssh root@your_vps_ip`. 2. Install Python & SQLite: `sudo apt update && sudo apt install python3 python3-pip python3-venv nginx -y`. 3. Clone/Upload project to `/var/www/sonicattend`. 4. Setup Virtual Environment: ```bash cd /var/www/sonicattend python3 -m venv venv source venv/bin/activate pip install flask gunicorn ``` 5. Create Systemd Service `/etc/systemd/system/sonicattend.service`: ```ini [Unit] Description=SonicAttend Flask Service After=network.target
[Service] User=www-data WorkingDirectory=/var/www/sonicattend ExecStart=/var/www/sonicattend/venv/bin/gunicorn --workers 3 --bind 127.0.0.1:5000 app:app Restart=always
[Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target ``` 6. Enable & Start service: ```bash sudo systemctl daemon-reload sudo systemctl start sonicattend sudo systemctl enable sonicattend ``` 7. Configure Nginx Reverse Proxy with SSL (Certbot Let's Encrypt).

target.name: Localhost Windows Execution
target.steps: Double-click `run_server.bat` or run `python app.py` in terminal. Open `http://127.0.0.1:5000/`.

project_specification.execution_checklist: - [x] Air-gapped Ultrasonic FSK Tone Synthesizer (18.5 - 19.8 kHz Web Audio API). - [x] 15-second Rotating TOTP Token Engine (HMAC-SHA256). - [x] Anti-Proxy Hardware Fingerprinting (1 Device = 1 USN lock). - [x] Dynamic Canvas FFT Audio Visualizer with live spectrum line. - [x] Real-time Attendance Roster with 1-click simulation trigger. - [x] Emergency Acoustic Fallback QR Modal with dynamic countdown. - [x] Official VTU Belagavi Print-Ready Attendance Sheet with college letterhead. - [x] Device Re-binding Ticket Workflow for HOD approval. - [x] De-AI codebase naturalization (0 robotic comments, clean developer syntax). - [ ] Real college weekly timetable ingestion (Mon-Sat period schedule). - [ ] Optional 1-second Camera Selfie Liveness Verification on mobile check-in.
